column1: # perf_shape.tsv — the parallel-overhead budget: TOTAL counter work (sum over

# production T1 entry point (encode_gzip_bytes_to_vec) and the production T>1
# per fixture (src/fixtures.rs) x level {1,2,6,9} x counter.
# THE ASSERTION IS ONE-SIDED: current T4/T1 ratio <= pinned T4/T1 ratio
# (cross-multiplied exactly, no floats). Less overhead PASSES and asks for a
# deliberate pin tightening; more fails naming the counter. Rows where t1=0
# pin an absolute T4 ceiling instead (a ratio over zero is unbounded).
# Counters price DIRECTION, not magnitude (-21% Ir moved wall 5.4%; -27%
# writes moved 0%): a ratio move names a mechanism, never a wall verdict.
